instruction: I need you to remove the "personal.inbox@outlook.com" account from Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing the personal email account 'personal.inbox@outlook.com' from Thunderbird. The evaluator validates that the account has been successfully removed by checking it's not in the account list.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: account removal is checked by verifying absence of the account in exported CSV
Postconfig appropriately uses firefox_decrypt.py to export Thunderbird account data after agent completes the removal task
Metric check_csv correctly implements unexpect logic: returns 1.0 if no CSV records match the account pattern (url='imap://outlook.office365.com', user='personal.inbox@outlook.com')
Getter get_cache_file correctly retrieves the exported CSV file path
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the core requirement (account no longer exists in Thunderbird profile)

Minor dependency risk: relies on third-party script firefox_decrypt.py output format, assumes CSV columns named 'url' and 'user' - if script outputs different column names (e.g., 'hostname', 'username'), the pattern matching would fail even if account data is present
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider documenting the expected CSV format from firefox_decrypt.py to ensure column name compatibility
Could add robustness by checking multiple possible column name variations (url/hostname/server, user/username/login) if the script format is uncertain
